capabilities: Detect changes from editor, Properties, Bases and external edits
Defer metadata writes until leaving, reading view or save
Preserve unrelated frontmatter and property blocks
disambiguation: Not a track-changes or annotation tool; it only updates timestamp and revision-count properties.
extras: Manual installation; warns to disable other automatic writers of these properties and test disposable notes before using a working vault; existing notes are not bulk-stamped or renamed.
problem: Automatic timestamp and revision metadata can be written during typing or on unchanged content, creating noise and interrupting editing.

relations.evidence: unrendered Templater expressions in frontmatter are deferred automatically.

summary: Plugin that updates created and updated timestamps and optional revision counts after editing sessions, deferring writes until a safe boundary.
